zh: 因为堵车，我要晚到一会儿。
en: I'm running late because of the traffic.
alt: The traffic's terrible, so I'll be a bit late.
point: “因为”后面是名词时用 because of，不是 because

zh: 虽然加班了，但是活儿干完了。
en: I had to stay late, but at least it's done.
alt: Even though I worked late, I got it finished.
point: “虽然…但是”英文只能选一个，不说 although … but

zh: 网太慢了，所以我关了摄像头。
en: The internet's really slow, so I've turned my camera off.
point: “因为…所以”二选一，这里只用 so

zh: 这台电脑虽然旧，还挺好用的。
en: This laptop's old, but it still works fine.
alt: Although this laptop's old, it still works fine.
point: “虽然…还”用 although 或 but 其一，再加 still

zh: 这家店很火，所以老要排队。
en: This place is really popular, so there's always a queue.
point: “火”是 popular；“要排队”说 there's a queue

zh: 甜点不要了，太饱了。
en: I'll skip dessert — I'm too full.
alt: I won't have dessert because I'm stuffed.
point: 中文不用连词，英文要用破折号或 because 连起来

zh: 我们输了，不过踢得不错。
en: We lost, but we played well.
alt: We lost, though we played pretty well.
point: “不过”就是 but，不用 although

zh: 今天膝盖疼，所以没去跑步。
en: My knee's sore, so I skipped my run today.
alt: I skipped my run because my knee hurts.
point: “疼”常说 sore；结果前用 so

zh: 太贵了，我就没买。
en: It was too expensive, so I didn't get it.
alt: I didn't buy it because it was too dear.
point: 中文“就”是结果，英文要补 so

zh: 既然打折，就多买几个吧。
en: Since it's on sale, let's get a few more.
alt: Seeing as it's on special, let's grab a few.
point: “既然”是 since，不是 already

zh: 我们坐火车去的，因为比开车便宜。
en: We took the train because it was cheaper than driving.
point: 原因放后面用 because，两边都用过去时

zh: 虽然很远，但是值得去。
en: It's a long way, but it's worth it.
alt: Even though it's far, it's worth the trip.
point: 不说 although … but；值得是 worth it，不说 worth to go

zh: 我感冒了，所以今天在家。
en: I've got a cold, so I'm staying home today.
point: “感冒了”是 I've got a cold，不是 I'm cold

zh: 难怪你这么累。
en: No wonder you're so tired.
alt: That's why you're so tired.
point: “难怪”是 no wonder，后面直接接句子

zh: 外面太吵了，我把窗户关了。
en: It was really noisy outside, so I shut the window.
point: 中文不用连词，英文要用 so 连接原因和结果

zh: 我家虽然小，但很温馨。
en: Our place is small but cosy.
alt: Our house is small, but it's really homely.
point: 一个 but 就够了；cosy 是英式拼写

zh: 我去不了，因为要加班。
en: I can't make it because I'm working late.
point: “去不了”是 can't make it；“加班”说 working late

zh: 我很想去，可是我明天一早要上班。
en: I'd love to, but I've got an early start tomorrow.
point: 婉拒先说 I'd love to, but；“一早上班”是 an early start

zh: 我没带现金，所以刷卡吧。
en: I've got no cash, so I'll pay by card.
alt: No cash on me, so I'll just tap my card.
point: “刷卡”是 pay by card / tap，不是 brush card

zh: 钱是挣得多，可是花得也多。
en: I earn good money, but I spend a lot too.
point: “A是A，可是…”只用 but，不必重复动词

zh: 因为下周放假，所以报告得这周五交。
en: Since next week's a holiday, the report needs to be in by this Friday.
alt: Next week's a public holiday, so the report's due this Friday.
point: 因为…所以只留一个；“交”是 be in / be due

zh: 他虽然是新来的，但对系统已经很熟了。
en: Even though he's new, he already knows the system inside out.
alt: He's new, but he already knows the system really well.
point: 用 even though 就不再加 but；很熟是 know … inside out

zh: 服务器昨晚宕机了，所以大家今天早上都登不上去。
en: The server went down last night — that's why nobody could log in this morning.
point: “所以才”可用 that's why，后面用陈述语序

zh: 驱动我更新了，打印机还是不能用。
en: I updated the driver, but the printer still won't work.
alt: Even though I've updated the driver, the printer still isn't working.
point: 中文没有“但是”，英文要加 but，“还是”用 still

zh: 这家的馥芮白太好喝了，我每天早上都来买。
en: The flat whites here are so good that I come in every morning.
alt: Their flat whites are amazing, so I'm in here every morning.
point: “太…所以”可用 so … that，so 放形容词前

zh: 菜虽然上得慢，但味道真的没话说。
en: The food took ages to come out, but it was absolutely delicious.
point: 只用 but；“上得慢”是 took ages to come out

zh: 既然雨停了，我们还能打一场高尔夫。
en: Now that the rain's stopped, we can still get a round of golf in.
alt: Since it's stopped raining, we've still got time for a round of golf.
point: “既然”除了 since，也常说 now that

zh: 他们队虽然少了一个人，最后还是赢了。
en: Even though they were a player down, they still managed to win.
point: 不说 although … but；“少一个人”是 a player down

zh: 我本来想买那双鞋，可是没有我的码了。
en: I was going to get those shoes, but they didn't have my size.
point: “本来想”是 was going to；“没码”是 didn't have my size

zh: 我是会员，所以在那家店买东西能打九折。
en: I'm a member, so I get ten percent off there.
alt: Because I'm a member, I get 10% off at that shop.
point: “打九折”是 ten percent off，不是 ninety percent

zh: 因为签证还没下来，我们只好推迟旅行。
en: Our visas haven't come through yet, so we've had to put the trip off.
point: 因为…所以只用 so；“签证下来”是 come through

zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们还是走完了汤加里罗步道。
en: We still did the Tongariro Crossing even though it was pouring.
alt: Even though it was bucketing down, we finished the Tongariro Crossing.
point: “尽管…还是”用 even though + still，不加 but

zh: 我最近在吃抗生素，所以不能喝酒。
en: I'm on antibiotics at the moment, so I can't drink.
point: “在吃药”是 be on antibiotics，不是 eating medicine

zh: 虽然医生说没什么大问题，我还是有点担心。
en: The doctor said it's nothing serious, but I'm still a bit worried.
alt: Even though the doctor says it's nothing major, I'm still a bit worried.
point: 只用 but + still，不要 although … but

zh: 开暖气太费电了，所以冬天我们在家都多穿几件。
en: Heating costs a fortune, so we just wear extra layers at home in winter.
point: “费电”是 costs a fortune；“多穿几件”是 wear layers

zh: 我们搬到这边是因为离孩子学校近。
en: We moved here because it's close to the kids' school.
point: “是因为”直接用 because，不说 is because

zh: 他平时挺安静的，不过喝两杯以后话就多了。
en: He's usually pretty quiet, though he opens up after a couple of drinks.
alt: He's normally quite quiet, but he gets chatty after a few drinks.
point: though 可放中间表转折；“话多了”是 opens up

zh: 既然你都请我吃饭了，下次咖啡我请。
en: Since you shouted dinner, coffee's on me next time.
alt: Seeing as you paid for dinner, next coffee's my shout.
point: “既然”用 since / seeing as；“我请”是 on me

zh: 最近汇率太差，所以这个月我先不往国内汇钱了。
en: The exchange rate's terrible right now, so I won't send any money home this month.
point: 因为…所以只用 so；“往国内汇钱”是 send money home

zh: 这个账户虽然利息高，但是取钱要提前通知。
en: This account pays good interest, but you have to give notice to withdraw.
alt: Although the interest rate's high on this account, you need to give notice before withdrawing.
point: 只用 but；“利息高”是 pays good interest

zh: 由于项目预算被砍了，我们不得不把上线时间推迟一个月。
en: Because the project budget's been cut, we've had to delay the go-live by a month.
alt: The budget's been slashed, so we've had no choice but to push go-live back a month.
point: “由于”用 because 就行；“不得不”是 have had to

zh: 这个方案前期投入是高一点，不过维护起来省事多了，长远来看是划算的。
en: This option costs a bit more upfront, but it's much easier to maintain, so it'll pay for itself in the long run.
point: “是…一点，不过”用 but；“长远来看”是 in the long run

zh: 我们之所以选 Azure，主要是因为客户那边已经在用微软全家桶了。
en: The main reason we went with Azure is that the client's already using the whole Microsoft stack.
alt: We chose Azure mainly because the client's already using Microsoft for pretty much everything.
point: “之所以…是因为”说 the reason … is that，不说 is because

zh: 测试环境都通过了，可一上生产还是出了问题，所以得好好查查配置哪里不一样。
en: Everything passed in test, but it still fell over in production, so we need to dig into what's different about the config.
point: “可…还是”用 but … still；“出问题”是 fell over

zh: 这家餐厅虽然贵了点，但服务和菜品都没得挑，所以周年纪念我们还是订了这里。
en: It's a bit on the pricey side, but the food and service are faultless, so we've booked it for our anniversary anyway.
point: “贵了点”是 on the pricey side；不要 although … but

zh: 他们说厨房人手不够，所以今晚只有套餐，不能单点。
en: They said they're short-staffed in the kitchen, so they're only doing a set menu tonight, nothing à la carte.
point: “人手不够”是 short-staffed；“只有套餐”用 only doing

zh: 上半场我们其实踢得挺好，可惜最后几分钟防守一松懈，被对方扳平了。
en: We actually played really well in the first half, but we switched off in the last few minutes and they equalised.
point: “可惜”不必直译，用 but 转折；“被扳平”说 they equalised

zh: 尽管黑蕨队赢了，很多球迷还是觉得她们远没发挥出真正的水平。
en: Even though the Black Ferns won, a lot of fans reckon they didn't play anywhere near their best.
point: even though 后不能再加 but；“觉得”Kiwi 常说 reckon

zh: 这件外套网上看着挺好，到手质量一般，退货还得自己出运费，算了。
en: The jacket looked great online, but the quality's pretty average in real life, and since I'd have to pay for return postage, it's not worth sending back.
point: 中文不用连词，英文要补 but / since 把转折和原因连起来

zh: New World 这周咖啡特价，所以我才大老远开车跑过来。
en: New World's got coffee on special this week — that's why I drove all the way across town.
point: “所以我才”用 that's why；“特价”是 on special

zh: 我们本来打算自己开车去雷因加角，可是路太烂了，最后还是报了个大巴团。
en: We'd planned to drive up to Cape Reinga ourselves, but the road was so rough that we ended up doing a bus tour instead.
point: “本来打算”是 we'd planned to；“最后”是 ended up

zh: 既然你们在惠灵顿只待一天，我建议先去 Te Papa，毕竟免费，下雨也不怕。
en: Since you've only got one day in Wellington, I'd start with Te Papa — it's free, after all, and it doesn't matter if it rains.
point: “既然”是 since；“毕竟”是 after all，常放句中或句尾

zh: 药我已经连着吃了一个星期了，咳嗽还是没好，所以想再来看看。
en: I've been taking the medication for a week now, but the cough still hasn't cleared up, so I thought I'd come back in.
point: 中文没有“但是”，英文要加 but；“没好”是 hasn't cleared up

zh: 医生说我背疼主要是因为久坐，所以让我每隔一小时起来活动一下。
en: The doctor says my back pain's mostly down to sitting all day, so she's told me to get up and move every hour.
point: “是因为”可说 be down to；“每隔一小时”是 every hour

zh: 那套房子我们最后没租，位置虽然好，但是太潮了，冬天肯定长霉。
en: We didn't take the flat in the end — the location was great, but it was really damp, so it'd definitely get mouldy in winter.
point: 因果和转折拆开，用 but 再用 so；mouldy 英式拼写

zh: 既然房东不肯修，那我们只能先自己垫钱找人修，之后再从房租里扣。
en: Since the landlord won't fix it, we'll just have to pay for it ourselves and take it off the rent later.
alt: Seeing as the landlord refuses to fix it, we'll cover it ourselves and deduct it from the rent.
point: “既然”是 since；“不肯”用 won't；“扣”是 take it off

zh: 他虽然在新西兰住了十年，但还是不太懂这边的幽默。
en: Even though he's lived in New Zealand for ten years, he still doesn't quite get Kiwi humour.
point: even though 不跟 but；“不太懂”是 doesn't quite get

zh: 那天聚会我没去，不是不想去，是女儿突然发烧了。
en: It's not that I didn't want to come to the party — it's just that my daughter suddenly came down with a temperature.
point: “不是…是…”用 It's not that … it's just that

zh: 既然我们每个月在外卖上花这么多钱，还不如自己做饭，一年能省好几千。
en: Seeing as we're spending so much on takeaways every month, we might as well cook at home — we'd save a few grand a year.
point: “既然”也可说 seeing as；“还不如”是 might as well

zh: KiwiSaver 最近虽然亏了一点，但这是长期投资，所以我不打算换基金。
en: My KiwiSaver's taken a bit of a hit lately, but since it's a long-term thing, I'm not going to switch funds.
point: 不用 although … but；“亏了”是 taken a hit
